description: This file provides environment variable substitution utilities for configuration files, including parsing, substitution, error handling, and support for special syntax like escaping and missing variable warnings.

classes.name: MissingEnvVarError
classes.description: Custom error class thrown when a required environment variable is missing during substitution.

methods.name: parseEnvTokenAt
methods.description: Parses environment variable tokens at a specific position in a string, identifying escaped or substitution patterns.

methods.name: substituteString
methods.description: Performs environment variable substitution within a string, handling escaping and missing variables.

methods.name: containsEnvVarReference
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any environment variable references.

methods.name: resolveConfigEnvVars
methods.description: Recursively resolves environment variable references in a configuration object.
